title: PartnerState
description: The Doudou Rabbit relationship state with one child (ADR-013; blueprint: Partner Relationship Memory). A projection over the event log. Powers story callbacks ('还记得昨天的小星星吗') and trust-aware narration. Feeds prompts; never moves numeric state (ADR-012 boundary).

partner_id.description: e.g. 'doudou_rabbit'. Single fixed partner; other roles are guests (blueprint Q3: C).

trust_level.description: Derived from engagement signals (return rate, initiated interactions, callback responses). A projection, recomputable.

current_thread.description: The ongoing shared storyline (zh), if any.

callbacks_available.description: Memorable moments eligible for story callbacks.

moment.description: The shared memory in child-facing phrasing (zh), e.g. '小星星'.

relationship_memory.description: Curated relationship facts (ADR-012 Growth Memory discipline).
